question: Rechna Doab is located between:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ravi and Chenab rivers.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rechna Doab** is located between Ravi and Chenab rivers.
 
• The Doab is called the 'area between two rivers'. Such as the land between the Ganges and the Yamuna.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
